notes.title: Divine Dawn 0.34 Release!
notes.notes:
Definitely took longer than I'd hoped, but there are a lot of large scenes here, important to each character's development, so hopefully it's worth the wait!

I'm especially fond of the Ina, Siofra, and Rosalyn scenes - I decided to try to focus on them to catch them up a bit to others and ensure they felt like full relationships, and in the first two cases, members of the camp.

Changelog;

 Rosalyn gets two giant scenes, one full of reveals about her character - and your backstory - and another that's more about your growing relationship with each other. God I wish she would hug me.
 Sarah, Ashley, and Metatron get a daytime conversation, touching on Bariura lore and giant mecha.
 Siofra gets Trust 8, Affection 4, and Affection 6 scenes, significantly deepening your relationship with her and revealing more of her (mostly) likeable side.
 Ina gets Trust 8, Trust 10, and Affection 8 scenes, showcasing a lot more of our favorite princess, plenty of Atlantis lore, and hinting at the start of a relationship.
 Aspasia gets a Trust 12 scene with a moral quandary and some of her being surprisingly sweet.
 Sam gets an Affection 16, following up her date withsome character development and cute moments!
 Maya gets an Affection 12, which is equal parts her shitposting, lore about the east, and admitting you're alright, which is basically a declaration of love from her.
 Sarah gets an affection 18, very comfy and sweet. Comfort food reading and I love her for it.


I'll be taking a short break to recuperate and finalize my plans for the next update, will post again in a few days, and fix bugs/typos as they are reported. Have fun!

notes.title: Divine Dawn 0.33 Release
notes.notes:
Divine Dawn 0.33 is finally out! Definitely took longer than I hoped, but it's a meaty update with more scenes than usual, and most of them are much larger than usual to boot, with several in the 4-5k+ word range.


 Rosalyn gets two new scenes, a conversation (visit her after the Astrologia setup group scene) and a second conversation followed by a paizuri CG (choose Flirt in the conversation menu).
 Aspasia gets a trust 10 scene, discussing golems, artificial intelligence, and what souls are. She loves this stuff.
 Ina gets a 6 affection scene, which includes some discussion on whether Kuril or the MC would rock a dress better, along with more discussion of what relations are.
 Sarah gets a 16 affection scene, with some MC childhood lore drops and her trying to be a supportive girlfriend. She's doing her best.
 Ashley gets a 14 affection scene, discussing succubus lore and Ashley's stellar descriptive skills when she's trying to make a point. Especially when she's horny.
 Siofra gets 2, 4, and 6 trust scenes, all of them very meaty and deeply philosophical. She has a lot more going on than 'smug goofy forest lady' and is happy to challenge the MC as well as be challenged by him. I meant that intellectually, but she would probably also be into ranked competitive sex.
 Siofra also gets a 2 affection scene with some shameless flirting and fun lore. There WAS a 4 affection scene, but I lost it, and I'm still hopping mad two weeks later. I was really happy with it man. I'll rewrite it in a future update.
 Sarah and Ashley get a massive evening affection scene, showing their growing bonds with the MC as well as a variety of conversation topics. Sarah is very cute and gets one extra bit if you have high strength, otherwise it's just a trio of goofs in a complicated relationship.

notes.title: Divine Dawn 0.32 Release!
notes.notes:
For once, I actually managed to stick to a schedule. Miracles can happen! Anyways, over the last few weeks I busted ass to fit in all the main content I had hoped to for this update, with a good mix of new stuff and content expansions for various girls. Sarah was definitely the big winner here, with a fancy new CG provided by Aragiken, but Ina, Maya, and Metatron all got some significant love too.

Changelog;

 Sarah got a new lovey thighjob CG, attached to a very... ethereal sort of scene. If you needed a reminder that she's a succubus, not a normal girl, this is it.
 Sarah also got a new trust scene, with a bit of character development, bonding, and hints for the future. Not all of them are good! Her finalizing her decision to invite Celica for the upcoming library research trip is, though.
 Sarah also got an amusing new conversation, in which you and she discuss Ashley's viability as the true Demon Queen. Her answer may or may not surprise you.
 Maya got a chonky new affection scene, which has her being almost suspiciously cute when she has her guard down. It also has doggo ear rubs. This is very important.
 Ina trust 4 and 6, delving heavily into Sahuagin lore and her feelings about it. Not all are positive, but it's a good bonding experience.
 Metatron gets a new trust 18, with a lot of emotions running rampant and a reveal of something that has been bothering her for some time. Robo-angel-wife has been going through a lot, please support her.
 As always, I'll take a few days off to recuperate and fix bugs as needed, then get to work on the next update. Not sure exactly how long it will take - I don't wanna do any more giant 2 month updates, so probably more in the 2-4 week range, depends a bit on how much I want to fit in.

I did finally get a very special character's custom theme, so the next plot scene can happen with her in it. We'll see how ballsy I'm feeling later this week, lol.

Anyways! I hope you all enjoy the update! Let me know if there are any bugs or typos I missed, or if you just really enjoyed a scene - I love hearing feedback on that stuff, it can be hard to tell how well some scenes came out otherwise.

notes.title: Divine Dawn 0.31 Release!
notes.notes:
This one is mostly romancey, with a big focus on a very bespoke scene for Sam's first time, and most of the other girls getting something. Hopefully something for everyone. Failing that, next update will probably be a little more laid back, definitely faster, and have stuff for the girls I didn't do much with this time. More on that in a few days after this stabilizes and I decide exactly what I'm doing.

Changelog;

 Sam's actual first time (affection 14), with a massive date, relationship building, special backgrounds, and a new CG courtesy of Aragiken! Watch an unusually fancy aurora with her and realize that you are not immune to tomboy propaganda.
 Sam trust 16, which continues the events from her spar with Metatron and grants her a new Instant.
 Maya affection 8, which has some pretty funny sprite movement and Maya being abnormally honest (sometimes). She's a very good dog.
 General plot scene, which randomly occurs sometime after Ina joins. Bit of a callback to the scene when you leave on the adventure, with some character development and a fiery new arrival.
 Celica trust 10, which sets up the totally-not-a-date with her and Sarah in the coming updates, and also has our beloved gremlin being vulnerable and cute. She's always cute.
 Metatron affection 16, which starts off with her asking what it means for a woman to be demure, and kinda goes downhill from there.
 Ina affection 4, in which you and a princess decide how to handle the eventual race war you're going to start by sleeping around too much.
 As always, various bugfixes, I think I got everything people were complaining about but no doubt there will be 0.31a or b soon enough.

notes.title: Divine Dawn 0.30 Release
notes.notes:
Holy shit I did NOT think it would take this long after Severn to get playable Ina, but at least the wait is finally worth it - ya gurl has finally joined the crew! Also Kuril and Kandros, mostly for the like 3 people who just want more bros.

Changelog;

 Sarah affection 14, with entirely too much plot relevance to be in a random affection scene
 Maya trust 12, showcasing Maya being less of a gremlin than usual (barely)
 Metatron affection 14, in which Ashley is the MVP
 Metatron conversation 5, further proving that Hieroneiden did nothing wrong
 Ina joining scene (random event in camp, pass time/come back from adventure)
 Ina trust 2. Got wood? She does! I promise that will be vaguely amusing when you read it, but no refunds.
 Ina affection 2. Expect romance, get philosophical debates that get really depressing.
 Ina, Kuril, and Kandros playable. Each has unique traits, some with funky mechanics!
 Abilities are now sorted within an element by school. Martial arts are now color-coded by school as well - if people like it, I can do the same for magic schools.
 Does anyone even want to read 'assorted bugfixes?' I feel like every patch notes has them, I never know what they mean, and frankly I don't even remember what I fixed.

notes.title: Divine Dawn 0.29 Release!
notes.notes:
As promised, 0.29 is done right about when I hoped it would be. While it was a 2-week project, I put a lot of work into it, and I think it came out pretty equivalent to a normal update, if not one of the really big ones. Let me know how you feel about the content speed and quantity!

Changelog;

 Sarah gets her 12 trust, pushing us towards advanced nether magic and an upcoming Celica/Sarah brainiac scene!
 Sam and Metatron get a group scene, a sparring match that goes pretty hard. As does Sam.
 Sam and Metatron each get followup trust scenes, both of them important to the character, with some fun reveals - especially in Metatron's!
 Aspasia gets a massive new evening scene, which includes a lot of characterization, development, and a new CG courtesy of Aragiken making good use of her nature as a slime!
 Two new martial arts, Tiger and Crane, available from the start. Tiger is more aggressive, focusing on damage, bleeds, and a bit of utility; you can play it as a fast predator or patient hunter. Crane is more defensive, with plenty of ways to make yourself hard to kill and disrupt enemies, but lacks Tiger's damage output.
 Both have a Form channel, which works similar to Harp channels - free, but mutually exclusive. While the Form is active, all abilities of that style gain additional effects.
 The new martial arts each have 3 unique traits, some of which are only active when the Form is active.

notes.title: December 18th Progress Update
notes.notes:
Made solid progress last week! A couple of new scenes for Sarah, Sam, and Memetron, including the first fight scene I've done in a while - hopefully it's fun to read. Sarah has a new CG now in progress, lookin good from the sketch, and in process on some more music. Worked out two new martial arts, Crane and Tiger, which will be available right from the start so you can be a martial artist for the full game if desired. 

They also introduce the Form system, which is a slightly fancier version of channels; similar to Harp songs they are free but mutually exclusive and only work if you have the required weapon equipped. Each gives some amount of a stat, and changes something about almost every ability in that martial art. In this case, Tiger adds bleed on hit and Crane has a chance to inflict stun (if possible) or strip some resilience if they can't be stunned. Existing martial arts will get more abilities/Forms over time, tho those that are still in progress (sorry Ashley) may have to wait for it until the character figures out what the form should be.

Unlike Traits, you can easily switch between them in battle, but making them mutually exclusive encourages you to actually, you know, switch your fighting style when you switch between forms. We'll see how it goes over in practice.

I didn't bother with a break after last update cuz I wanted to try something different this time; a shorter update window, about two weeks. So I'm gonna aim for the next update around the end of this week, around the 21st-23rd, and just kinda see what I can fit into it. I'm pretty optimistic so far, I think I can get a surprisingly good amount of stuff in if I really burn the midnight oil, and then I can take an actual break afterwards.

notes.title: Divine Dawn 0.28 Release!
notes.notes:
Definitely took longer than I hoped, but I used that time to make the knight scene a lot chunkier and more reflective of past choices, so hopefully it feels worth it!

Changelog

 A massive combi-scene covering your return to the knight camp after the Deepwoods finale, with some significant plot development and some major callbacks to previous major choices. Also includes Ina being thirstier than usual, which is a feat in and of itself.
 Aspasia 12 and 14 affection scenes, pushing further into friendship and romance with the starstruck slime. Like, astronomy stars, not a metaphor for romance.
 Sarah 10 trust gets moving on her own Rocky training montage, which is unsurprisingly less violent than Ashley's. Slightly more messed up tho.
 Metatron 10 trust finally starts delving into Metatron's own martial art, as well as more trauma. That's gonna be a recurring theme.
 Ashley affection 12 is mostly really wholesome, with a side dish of PTSD. She's a good girl. Might purr if you pet her.
Greatsword rework; 4 new traits, a few new support abilities, and several new elemental skills. It's still probably not as busted as Greataxe, but *way* safer and plays more into the unstoppable juggernaut vibe.
 Some new music; Selendis and Ina each get their own themes!
 A new knight, with art from alhazart. Same guy who did Kuril, Kandros, Svyatibor, etc.

As always, let me know if you run into any bugs, so I can fix them!

notes.title: November 9th Progress Update
notes.notes:
Progress has been ongoing; Metatron, Ashley, and Aspasia are all getting their due, with some nice development that so far has been more focused on romance.

Man, I try to act like I always know what I'm doing but MAN I am so glad Aspasia is finally working out, I was kinda struggling to make her work and wondering if I'd made a mistake with her, but she's finally coming out to where I hoped, which is when all the 50 thousand years of plot I DID have planned for her can start to kick in, and she might actually feel like a real character!

Anyways, aside from that I have some commissions cooking, i don't really remember which/if any I've talked about publicly recently but I think the one I'm most happy with right now is the silver knight dude from the opening of the knight camp. No, he's not actually that important maybe, but FUCK his art came out cool, like now my brain is wondering "hmm how can I use him more often?" and that never goes anywhere good.

I think that late November (gunning for 21st, exact ETA to be determined) should work out fine, I've had my 'dicking around with random stuff I want to do' phase, now I gotta wrap that up and get to work properly on the Selendis/Ina/plot/PLOOOT stuff for the update. Kinda nice to have that moving along again.

notes.title: October 24th Progress Update
notes.notes:
Got to work on 0.28 last week after a short break, so far that was mostly fixing bugs, revamping Greatsword and adding a bunch of new traits/abilities, and some new Hydromancy stuff. This week has been more writing, more on that later.

Looking forward, I'm gonna aim to wrap up the Deepwoods plot in Badon in 0.28, likely including the return of Ina. Also gonna try to finally deliver on some of those Badon dates (especially Sam, maybe Sarah) and whatever else I can fit in - probably some combination of Sammance, possibly some Rosalyn, MAYBE Alicia but there always seems to be more setup needed for her lol.

For now, I'm not gonna promise the full wrapup of the actual deepwoods content, cuz I have a lot I want to do (siofra, zephyrmancy, some new minor characters, svyatibor and mara if alive, etc) and I'm terrible at estimating how long that will all take. Maybe dip my toe in it and see if I can get some done in a reasonable timeframe. Will finish whatever I don't get here in 0.29.

Gonna aim for mid-November this time, no more fuckin giant 2+ month updates lol. Maybe November and December 21 for the next two? We'll see how that goes as we get closer, would be nice to have a more consistent timeframe tho.

notes.title: Divine Dawn 0.27 Update
notes.notes:
Took longer than I had hoped, but finally got the update done. Focused mostly on the camp this time around, especially Aspasia's romance progression and a mix of romance and friendship for other characters, along with a *lot* of typo fixes and some missing expressions for older content.

I hope you enjoy the new content!

Changelog;

 Aspasia gets 4, 6, 8, and 10 affection scenes, as well as an 8 trust scene setting up future combat upgrades!
 Sam gets a 10 trust scene that lets you somewhat customize her playstyle, helping her synergize with various builds. There's a much smaller, separate scene in the Training tab that lets you change it at any time while in camp.
 Sarah gets a 12 affection scene that finally reveals one of her Aspects~
 Maya gets an evening hangout/lap pillow scene, unfortunately not involving her lap. She also gets a new missionary sex scene with a CG!

I need some damn sleep, but I'll keep an eye on bug/typo reports and dig into my error backlog over this week, and look into patching any issues.

Probably around Sunday I'll have another post up talking about what I plan/hope to do in the next update, which should rrrroughly follow the roadmap but I gotta figure out exactly what is feasible. Still gunning to go heavy on the plot stuff though, hopefully including my girl Ina - I'm jonesing to write her (and Kuril) again!

notes.title: 0.26a Minor Update
notes.notes:
Changelog


 Updated to Renpy 8, which is necessary for future development and will hopefully help Linux/Steam Deck compatibility

 Added a rest point directly after the Volos battle

The upgrade from Renpy 7 to 8 may cause unforeseen bugs - I playtested to catch the obvious ones, but some may be more pernicious. Please let me know if you run into any weird issues!

notes.title: Divine Dawn 0.26 Release!
notes.notes:
Divine Dawn 0.26 is finally out! Before we get to the changelog, I would like to thank you all for being so patient, and I hope that the sheer volume of new stuff will be well worth the wait!

I'd also like to thank everyone who helped beta test the update; there are probably still some typos and bugs, but the vast majority have been found despite many major backend changes. Too many people contributed for my senile old brain to keep track, but special shoutouts to Dunnask, Kronos, Grim, and Nobody for each sending in dozens or even hundreds of reports and suggestions over the last two months.

Now, the changelog;

A new area, the Deepwoods Heart. Chock full of plot, new art, and music, it will be a true test of your your abilities and your beliefs, with heavily divergent endings depending on your final choices.
Sarah gets a wholesome new CG and sex scene (night) as well as another talk (evening), both requiring high affection.
Celica gets a new Affection 12 scene pushing the relationship forward, as well as a shared hangout with Sam (evening).
Metatron gets a new conversation that starts off focused on abs and eventually segues into massive spoilers about exactly how thicc or bricc various angels are. Trust me, it's relevant to the plot.
Aspasia gets a new 6 Trust scene as your bond with her begins to grow and she gets a little bit snarkier.
Ashley gets a new conversation with Maya as oil and water mix into a big fucking problem. She also gets a followup conversation discussing her worldview.
Trait and now Ability dictionaries exist in the right-click menus, with better use of icons and separation to make 'em a bit easier to peruse. Hopefully helps for making new builds.
Chesed completely revamped into 7 new spells, while Malkuth got quite a few spellsword-oriented spells as well. Binah and Geburah got a few new spells apiece.
For some godawful reason a lot of active Charisma abilities didn't actually let you master them, which is now fixed.
A metric assload of new traits; Charisma gets a bunch that let you buff your allies passively, while healing magic (mostly Aether and Water) get a variety of specialized as well as generalized traits. Pyromancy got some love as well.
The Athame weapon gained several new elemental skills and traits, hopefully making it a strong option for a more dexterity-focused spellsword rather than a stat stick. Oh, and you can bleed yourself horribly for a short magic buff.
New stat icons! Also rearranged the display a bit. No functional changes.
Several existing characters now have new music; Maya's default, Sarah during her lewd scene, etc.
Several new themes for the Heart; there's a lot of new boss music to say the least!
Light channel balancing; each active channel increases the activation cost of the next. More thorough work will be done with them another time, this is somewhat experimental.
I know everyone hates the 'assorted bugfixes' thing every damn changelog has but bruh I'm not even going to try to type them out, there are hundreds. Shoutout to everyone who reported them!


Over the next few days, I'll focus on bug/typo reports and feedback I can easily implement.

Then, later this week, I'm going to do a tentative roadmap for the next few updates. I cannot promise exact dates, but with this abomination done, I think I can better gauge upcoming stuff for a bit.

notes.title: May 15th Weekly Update
notes.notes:
Pretty decent progress this time around. About 7k words, split across a weird variety of Ashley, Celica, Aspasia, Metatron, and Sam. Some romance, some friendship, and some shenanigans.

Also added a fair number of traits (and some abilities) to several weapons, especially Athame and other daggers. Some characters now have better builds/make better use of armor and trait options, and you can request some of the tankier characters draw heat for you - so Aspasia can actually make use of her ridiculous bulk.

Think we finally got the last few stat icons done too, so that should be in next update.

Summer heat kicking in BAD though, hope it aint as hot for you guys as it is here. Anyways, back to work!

notes.title: May 7th Weekly Update
notes.notes:
Got back to work this week! Actually went pretty well, despite being a tad rusty and having a lot going on IRL.

Around 8000 words of content written, with a few group scenes (Ashley/Maya, Sam/Celica) and one solo with Sarah. They all came out pretty well, though lowkey I'm super proud of the Sarah one, it's so nice to see her in comfy therapist mode.

Rosalyn and Ashley CGs got delivered as well; idk exactly when they'll make it into the game, but both artists (Nor and InCloud respectively) did a phenomenal job with the art! Lotta good expressions, and of course very lewd. Both are surprisingly affectionate too!

I forget if I even mentioned this one, but we also got a very cool giant birb art (non-waifu, sorry) that will likely be used in the post-deepwoods area.

Great progress on new stat icons, thanks to TheWiseHedgehog's amazing work. I think we have everything except for the Charisma icon nailed down and looking great!

I also went back and fixed almost all of the bugs/typos reported since 0.25 launch, though I confess some will take a little more work than I had hoped. My thanks to everyone who reported those, it's incredibly helpful for improving the game!

Gonna try to get some of the CG backlog implemented this week, there's actually more than I had realized floating around. Not the worst fate to have though. 'Oh no, a bunch of super high-quality lewd art, how terrible!' said no one ever.

Lastly, have a wide variety of sketches from Nor! Some are unbearably cute, some are goofy as hell, and some are dangerously good waifuizations of existing bosses/monsters. SvyatiMOMMY, god damn. It's honestly kinda crazy how good his art is, these were all sketches during a patron call that he just went super saiyan in like a god.

notes.title: Divine Dawn Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Divine Dawn is finally entering Early Access!

I've been working on this for about two years now, learning to code and practicing writing along the way, so it's incredibly cool to finally hit a milestone of this size! Grew up wanting to be a writer or a game developer, and uh, we're somewhere in that vicinity! Not quite how I expected to get there, but such is life.

As an Early Access title, there will be some scuff - I probably missed some bugs and typos, and Juno-Seto knows I'm not an expert in user interface design. I tried to catch everything possible, but I'm just an amateur dev rather than a triple-A company. So please bear with me, and report issues for me to fix!

As the Early Access description states, I intend to keep updating this game for a few years, and relying on feedback from you guys. I intend to stick to my overall vision for the game, but I've learned that constructive criticism is an incredibly powerful tool, and I will regularly update yall on my progress (weekly?) as well as solicit feedback on various things.

I suspect the first few days will involve a lot of bugfixing, but once I get an idea of how stable things are I'll post again to see what kind of news, update, and feedback cycles you guys would prefer.

In the meantime, enjoy the game! This has been my life for a few years now, and I truly hope it can bring joy to at least a few people out there.

notes.title: Release Soon!
notes.notes:
First off, I would like to thank everyone that participated in February's NEXT fest. I got some really helpful feedback about what was working and what aspects of the game, and UI, could use a bit of tuning. This will be an ongoing process - I am learning as I go - but I will continue to work at it!

Looking forward, the April 20th release date I had been aiming for still looks valid! I'll keep working on adding content and polishing stuff; there will be around another 30-40k words over what was in the NEXT fest by launch. So, you know, a short novel.

And of course, the 20th is just the start; I will continue updating the game long into the future. A few more years anyways, I'm not sure exactly how long it'll take to finish the planned content and what else will show up in the meantime.

I intend to solicit opinions on release cadence and update progress reports after release, to find out what you guys want to see and what I can commit to. Gotta take this seriously, and that means a minimum of tomfoolery on my end.
